Subject: one representative Sentosa Express (Singapore) monorail trainset car, matching actual photographs at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sentosa_Express . HITACHI small-type straddle-beam monorail car, 25 m two-car train, shown as ONE car. Long rounded-rectangular monorail body that STRADDLES a narrow concrete beam: no rails, no flanges, no pantograph, no catenary, no bogies visible under the floor. Wide near-black panoramic window band wrapping the upper body, flat white roof with two slim longitudinal roof ribs and a small air-conditioning hump, one wide double passenger door on the near side at each end of the car, smooth moulded nose with a large curved windscreen and a single rounded headlight cluster low on the nose. Body painted one solid bright colour — use PURPLE — with a narrow white band along the skirt and a light-grey roof; the real fleet paints each trainset a single solid colour (green, orange, blue, purple, pink, red, yellow), so keep this one flat solid purple, not multi-coloured, not a gradient, not the map line colour. Driverless, so no driver visible. NO MRT carriage proportions, no train coupling at the near end, no station platform, no beam or track under the vehicle. Front at UPPER-RIGHT, rear at LOWER-LEFT, long axis ascending left to right.

generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: small transparent PNG map vehicle sprite for Singapore traffic app.
Primary request: one representative conventional Singapore Cable Car passenger gondola cabin, reflecting the dark glazed red-roof cabins operated on the Singapore Cable Car network.
Reference evidence: Singapore Cable Car operator's gallery at https://mountfaberleisure.com/attraction/singapore-cable-car/ and operator photos https://mountfaberleisure.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/New-Web_480-x-360-47.jpg and https://mountfaberleisure.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/New-Web_480-x-360-48.jpg establish a conventional enclosed suspended gondola. This is the standard rounded rectangular cabin, not the spherical chrome SkyOrb.
Subject: one small rounded rectangular eight-seat gondola with large dark smoked panoramic windows on front and near side, black window pillars and dark charcoal lower shell, red shallow gently domed roof, slim light-grey curved suspension hanger rising above the roof to a compact cable grip. Show thin black door seams and small rim details. Cabin has a broad rectangular footprint with softened chamfered corners and tapers very slightly near the floor. No cartoon ski lift form. Suspension hardware is structurally connected to roof and fully inside frame.
Style/medium: crisp realistic miniature 3D product render, compact map-icon level of detail, restrained physically believable glossy paint and dark glass, clear silhouette and softly highlighted edges. Same clean polished transit icon family as miniature MRT and LRT cutouts.
Composition/framing: single entire cabin and hanger isolated and centered on a square canvas, elevated three-quarter isometric view seeing red roof, front, near side and hanging attachment, about 8 percent transparent padding around the complete silhouette.
Lighting: soft studio illumination from upper-left, restrained contrast.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent background with alpha; all empty space and openings transparent, no floor, no cast shadow, no grey or white backdrop.
Constraints: no cable extending across canvas, no scenery, no station, no people, no lettering, no route color badge, no logo, no watermark, no promotional characters, no extra cabins. Preserve actual red roof and dark glazing. This is representative normal cabin livery; do not reproduce temporary advertising.
generation.postProcessing: Replaced the red roof pixels with graphite, preserved the chrome trim and alpha, and added a cyan LED strip under the roof lip. Artwork remains within the original 16 px framing.
generation.note: The existing ImageGen source cabin was recoloured locally; no new image-generation run was made.
